identity_rule: origin entity_id, origin_species_id and visual_identity_id remain authoritative through assimilation, drone state, disconnection, liberation and recovery unless an explicit world rule creates a genuinely separate entity.

assimilation_overlays: dermal pallor or altered surface presentation where supported
liberation_recovery: removed implants leave only state-supported residual structures/scars
skin/hair/soft-tissue recovery evolves over time rather than resetting identity

variation_rules: Implant coverage and topology may vary substantially between drones.
Asymmetry is allowed and common in the supplied references.
The same persistent person keeps traceable underlying morphology beneath different Borg states.
Origin species traits may remain visible where not physically obscured or altered.
forbidden: rerolling the face during assimilation or liberation
copying one canonical drone implant layout as a universal template
adding implants solely for spectacle without state/function provenance
treating implant configuration as personality or knowledge
assuming Collective access exposes all World Truth
nap_requirements: persistent implant/modification refs required when established
later assets must reference the same visual identity lineage
